title: Udo Akpabio, warrant chief of Ukana
by: the British administration of Ikot Ekpene Division
text: Udo Akpabio of Ukana, Ikot Ntuen, in Ikot Ekpene Division was a warrant chief; his son Ibanga Akpabio became a leader of the independence era. The arrogance of the warrant chiefs’ tribunals, forced labour and taxes were among the grievances that gave rise to the Ibibio Union.
note: The years of his office are not in the sources consulted.
